title: Construction of the signed homogeneous normal frame
statement: Let k be a field, U,V affine schemes with finite-type structure maps aU,aV to Spec k, h:U→V a separated smooth morphism of pure relative dimension d with h≫aV=aU, and c:U→A^d_V an etale V-map. There exists a NormalFrame for x_i=c^*t_i as defined in [def-pur-diagonal-difference-frame-data]. No centred deformation chart or chart-change conclusion is asserted here.

proof.text: Use the normalized diagonal conormal identification. Construct the representative of p2*a−p1*a directly in the kernel and transport it through the ideal-kernel isomorphism. This fixes the positive sign. Combine the differential basis with the inverse conormal comparison.

source.place: Steps 1–3 and change of frame; detailed proof of lem-pur-diagonal-difference-rees-frame

proof.text: Use the canonical symmetric comparison and the polynomial symmetric algebra basis. The relative-Spec counit identifies the cone with affine space and gives the coordinate equation on all opens. Augmentation proves the zero-section equation. Degree-one cone extensionality and normalized affine Rees formulas give independence of the comparison. An empty free basis has zero conormal and the symmetric-algebra universal property identifies Sym(0) with the unit algebra.

theorem normal_frame_exists (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V]
    (aU : U ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (aV : V ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aU] [LocallyOfFiniteType aV]
    (d : ℕ) (h : U ⟶ V) [IsSeparated h] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    (hk : h ≫ aV = aU)
    (c : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V) [Etale c]
    (hc : c ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V ↘ V) = h) :
    Nonempty (NormalFrame d h (fun i ↦ c.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V i)))
